limits: Real isolated SQLite, DAL, memberships and actions; authentication and Next cache mocked.
No local server or container, no real provider, file or hosted database modification.
Browser execution, PostgreSQL and hosted qualification must identify the published candidate.
Separate selection is rechecked per request, not a perpetual authorization after revocation; no hosted load benchmark.
